description: The per-pixel GLSL OpenDRT never matched core (149 levels, 98% mismatch on device). core now bakes the transform into a 65^3 table on DaVinci Intermediate code axes (cached per spec) and the TAIL variant is DI encode + by-hand trilinear over it; the CPU reference applies the same table (applyOpenDrtBaked), so the two agree like every other LUT stage. Lattice error against the direct transform: worst 0.39 LSB, mean 0.078 LSB (desktop test, 4096-sample log sweep). Device v2 sweep: drt-sdr 0.003%, drt-hlg 0.001%, nodes+drt 0.001%, all max 1 LSB (bound 0.01%, unchanged); encoded frame + OpenDRT SDR 0.0023% / HLG 0.0000%. The encoded GPU door and window arm no longer fall back to the CPU for an OpenDRT chain. JVM green, desktop 0.
